mfa-selector.title: Multi-Factor Authentication
mfa-selector.description: Select your preferred method for multi-factor authentication.
mfa-selector.emailOtpDescription: Receive a one-time password via your registered email address.
mfa-selector.smsOtpDescription: Receive a one-time password via your mobile number.
mfa-selector.authenticatorDescription: Use an authenticator app to generate a time-based one-time password.
mfa-selector.pushNotificationDescription: Receive a push notification on your mobile device for authentication.
mfa-selector.duoSecurityDescription: Use Duo Security for multi-factor authentication.
mfa-selector.passkeyDescription: Use a passkey for secure authentication.
